label: Town of Shrewsbury
header:
# Town of Shrewsbury municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 21; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term
Town of Shrewsbury, published results of the March 3, 2026 annual meeting (Australian ballot): Eldred French was re-elected Moderator with 167 votes
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk
Town of Shrewsbury, 2025 Annual Report, '2025 Elected Town Officers as of December 31, 2025' table: Rebecca Rice holds the clerk's term to 2027
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Rebecca Rice as Shrewsbury's Town Clerk
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer
Town of Shrewsbury, 2025 Annual Report, '2025 Elected Town Officers as of December 31, 2025' table: Linda McGuire holds the treasurer's term to 2027
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Linda McGuire as Shrewsbury's Town Treasurer

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Shrewsbury's three selectboard members: Marc Cimonetti (the directory's 'Cimonette' is a misprint -- its own email for him reads mcimonetti), Aaron Korzun (Chairman), and Francis Wyatt

Town of Shrewsbury, published results of the March 3, 2026 annual meeting (Australian ballot): Francis Wyatt was re-elected with 154 votes; Marc Cimonetti's term runs to 2028 and Aaron Korzun's to 2027
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect auditors (three, staggered terms) unless the office is eliminated
Town of Shrewsbury, 2025 Annual Report, '2025 Elected Town Officers as of December 31, 2025' table: Sanford Bragg holds an auditor term to 2027

Town of Shrewsbury, published results of the March 3, 2026 annual meeting (Australian ballot): Michelle Greene was re-elected auditor with 156 votes; the two-year auditor contest drew only write-ins and 'no candidate received the requisite number of votes', so the third seat stands vacant
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a first constable

Town of Shrewsbury, published results of the March 3, 2026 annual meeting (Australian ballot): the 2026 first constable contest drew only write-ins and produced no winner, so the post stands without a membership
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a second constable

Town of Shrewsbury, published results of the March 3, 2026 annual meeting (Australian ballot): Steve Walsh was elected Second Constable with 158 votes (the 2025 report shows him holding the seat by appointment; the ballot form 'Steve Walsh' is recorded as the candidacy name for Stevenson Walsh)

Town of Shrewsbury, 2025 Annual Report, '2025 Elected Town Officers as of December 31, 2025' table: Benny Carrara and Eric Carrara hold cemetery terms to 2027
Town of Shrewsbury, published results of the March 3, 2026 annual meeting (Australian ballot): George Brigham Jr. was re-elected a Cemetery Commissioner with 173 votes
